title: feat(Sustainability): Add Reverse Transaction for Sustainability Ledger Entries
summary: Users can now reverse posted Sustainability Ledger Entries manually from the page or automatically when their originating G/L transaction is reversed, with all emission fields negated and the reversal posted on the original entry's date.
key_points: Manual reversal action added to Sustainability Ledger Entries page with confirmation
Automatic reversal triggered when a G/L transaction that produced sustainability entries is reversed
New fields track reversal status: Reversed, Reversed by Entry No., Reversed Entry No.
All emission fields (CO2, CH4, N2O, CO2e, Carbon Fee, Water, Waste, Energy) are negated in the reversal entry
Reversal entry posted on original entry's date to ensure emissions net to zero within same period
quote: Add the ability to reverse posted Sustainability Ledger Entries, matching the established G/L reversal pattern.
